content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm new to this forum and need assistance with my [product_name] network. I have 4 [product_name] modules: three are [article_no] models and one is [article_no]. My goal is to configure the web server on the [product_name] so I can monitor IOs on my network and possibly control them if feasible. While setting up the network input, I am prompted for a TSAP parameter, which I do not understand. Any support would be appreciated. Best regards, [user_name]

I've managed to get the web server running and can access it via PC (though access from iPhone and iPad isn’t working yet). I'm now wondering if it's possible to create a variable input on the web server. I can't seem to assign an input in the VM mapping parameter. Thanks, [user_name]

Hello, Generally, it is not possible to set an input—[product_name] will always overwrite it. The [product_name] Web-Server is based on TDE functionality. If you have created a message text for TDE or the onboard display, you can enable these texts for the Web-Server. For operation, use the cursor or F-keys in your program, which can also be accessed through the web server. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is working on enabling the web server feature on a [product_name] module to monitor and manage IOs over their network. They face challenges with understanding configuration parameters like TSAP and discover the web server cannot set input values. There are also compatibility issues with certain devices such as iPhone and iPad, complicating remote access and usability.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects straightforward remote configuration through the web server, the ability to monitor and potentially control IO points, clarity on parameters such as TSAP, and broad compatibility with various devices including PC, iPhone, and iPad.
